title: CJP launches ‘Kya Bolti Public’ campaign in Goa; Dipke hails Goans’ support for Jantar Mantar protest

ai.summary: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) launched its 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign in Goa, expressing surprise at local support for their Delhi protest at Jantar Mantar.

facts.claim: CJP launched 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign in Goa
facts.quote: CJP has taken its 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign to Goa

facts.claim: Dipke expressed surprise at Goans' support for Jantar Mantar protest
facts.quote: Dipke said the party was unaware that people in Goa had taken to the streets in solidarity with its protest at Jantar Mantar

facts.claim: CJP leader Ashutosh Ranka and co-convenor Saurav Das attended the campaign launch
facts.quote: Co-convenor Saurav Das, CJP leader Ashutosh Ranka were also present at the convention centre

ai.background_note: CJP is a political party that has been involved in protests, including a protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi and a campaign in Kerala. The party has been granted conditional bail after a detention and arrest in October.
